description: This file defines a class 'jpgraph' with methods to generate various charts (bar, pie, pipeline) related to potentials (opportunities) in a CRM system, including functions for rendering images and image maps, and references external libraries for graphing and utilities.

classes.name: jpgraph
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate various charts (bar, pie, pipeline) for CRM potentials data.

methods.name: outcome_by_month
methods.description: Generates a bar chart image showing potential outcomes over months for specific users.

methods.name: lead_source_by_outcome
methods.description: Creates a pie or bar chart showing potential outcomes by lead source for specific users.

methods.name: pipeline_by_sales_stage
methods.description: Creates a bar chart showing potential pipeline by sales stage for specific users.

methods.name: pipeline_by_lead_source
methods.description: Creates a pie or bar chart showing potential pipeline by lead source for specific users.
